sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gunsmith Master - Part 11 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Got a new order for you. I need a KAC SR-25 rifle. CMMG Mk3 handguard, KAC PRS/QDC silencer, SE-5 grip, PRS GEN3 buttstock, HK Ergo PSG-1 style pistol grip, DBAL-PL tactical unit, FastFire 3 red dot on a 45 degree rail, 10 round magazine, and a FLIR thermal scope. Yeah, I know it's rare nowadays, but order is an order. Oh, also you need ergonomics no lower than 25 and weight no higher than 6 kg."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Modify a KAC SR-25 to comply with the given specifications

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +31,250 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.03
- 1,500 Euros
  - 1,575 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 1,725 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 3× Pipe grip wrench
- 2× FP-100 filter absorber
"I'd expect nothing less from you!"

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
KAC SR-25 specifications:
- 60 Durability
- 25 or more ergonomics
- 6 kg or less in weight
- KAC PRS/QDC 7.62x51 sound suppressor
- Stark SE-5 Express Forward foregrip (Black)
- AR-15 Magpul PRS GEN3 stock
- AR-15 HK Ergo PSG-1 style pistol grip
- Steiner DBAL-PL tactical device
- Burris FastFire 3 reflex sight
- NcSTAR MPR45 Backup mount
- AR-10 7.62x51 KAC 10-round steel magazine
- FLIR RS-32 2.25-9x 35mm 60Hz thermal riflescope
Note: Despite the quest specifying a CMMG Mk3 handguard, any is currently accepted.

sections.heading: Notes:
sections.text:
- This build is based on a standard black SR-25 from Peacekeeper LL3.
- The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
